Discover Stillvaro 2.0: connected practice, Watch and Explore, Learning trends, the Memory Spiral, and untimed tests.
Stillvaro 2.0 — Memorize the digits of π. Four digits at a time.

article.p: A new way into π — from your first four digits to the connections that make them your own.
Introducing Stillvaro 2.0 for iPhone, iOS 26 or later. This page describes version 2.0; check the App Store for the version available in your region.

Learn in groups of four with Guide and Memory. Join groups into passages of up to sixteen digits, with practice that returns to difficult connections. Tap the dial or drag and pause to enter each digit. Your place and unfinished input save automatically.

Watch demonstrates the sequence with a choice of speed and repeats. Explore π lets you browse four, eight, or sixteen digits, highlight a group’s shape, and practice from a chosen place before returning to your earlier input.
article.h2: A clearer view of your learning
article.p: Learning trends brings together three views of a selected section: Recall & guidance charts, the Group by group heatmap, and Where slips happen. Touch a saved snapshot to inspect the percentage and attempt count. See what the numbers mean.

Switch between My journey, which shows practiced groups, and Explore π, which includes every available group without changing your progress. Play the shapes of π as a spiral. Pause to pan and pinch to zoom, fit the whole spiral, or focus on the current movement.
Test without hints, with four attempts per group. See uninterrupted recall, digits checked, and personal bests from the same starting place. Return to practice restores your saved session.

Stillvaro supports VoiceOver, larger text, appearance choices, haptics, and motion and contrast preferences. Practice and learning schedules run on your iPhone, without an account, advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs.

Progress saves locally with recovery handling. The current app does not offer progress import/export, automatic cloud sync, or a Home Screen widget. Manage any device backups or files exported by older versions separately. Read the privacy policy.

p.a: View Stillvaro on the App Store ↗

div.p: A little practice. A different way to see π.
